dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_rise Understand the notion of SNL. Ultimately Elon advocates for trading with caution. If he’d gone out there and loved all over doge it would have had an unreasonable uptick, making it unrealistic. The smart people will buy the dip I’m sure he and Cuban have.
